terms.gloss: old age, age, long existence; ancient times
evidence: Cic. Phil. 3.15: mūnicipium vetustāte antīquissimum (Lewis & Short)
Cic. de Or. 2.36: historia nūntia vetustātis (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: nunc fāmā rērum standum est, ubi certam dērogat vetustās fidem
phrases.english: now we must stand by the tradition, where great age takes away sure knowledge

phrases.latin: maxima est enim vīs vetustātis et cōnsuētūdinis
phrases.english: for the force of long standing and of habit is very great

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
